settings.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
settings.content:
We want to ensure your pet safety gear arrives quickly, safely, and in perfect condition. This Shipping & Delivery Policy outlines our fulfillment processes, shipping methods, delivery timeframes, tracking systems, and associated fees.

1. Processing and Fulfillment Timeframes

  • Fulfillment Center Hours: Our warehouses operate and pack shipments Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays.
  • Standard Order Processing: Most orders are processed, packed, and handed to the shipping carrier within 1 to 3 business days from the time of order confirmation.
  • Custom Personalization Orders: For custom laser-engraved items (like our Personalized ID Tag), please allow an additional 1-2 business days for production and quality inspection prior to shipment.

You will receive an automated email notification containing your custom tracking link as soon as your shipping label is printed and scanned by the carrier.

2. Shipping Methods and Delivery Timeframes

We partner with major global shipping carriers (including USPS, DHL, and local postal systems) to provide reliable delivery. Delivery times depend on customer location and warehouse stock availability.

Standard Insured Shipping:

  • United States: 7 to 12 business days
  • Canada & United Kingdom: 8 to 14 business days
  • Australia & New Zealand: 10 to 15 business days
  • Rest of the World: 12 to 20 business days

Note: These timeframes are estimates. Occasional carrier delays, custom clearances, or holiday rushes may extend transit times slightly.

3. Shipping and Handling Fees

  • Standard Catalog Orders: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on package weight and destination country.
  • Promotional "FREE + Shipping" Offers: For promotional "FREE" campaigns, the product is sold for $0.00, and the customer covers a flat-rate shipping and handling fee of $9.95 per item. This fee covers our actual shipping carrier rates, custom packaging materials, warehouse handling labor, and priority fulfillment processing.

4. Tracking Your Order

Every shipment is fully insured and comes with a trackable shipping number. Once your order has been dispatched, you can follow its journey using the tracking number sent to your email. If you have not received your tracking information within 5 business days of placing your order, please email us at support@safepetstrap.com for assistance.

5. Missing, Lost, or Damaged Shipments

  • Wrong Address Entry: Please ensure your delivery address is accurate before finishing your checkout. We are not responsible for shipments that cannot be delivered due to typos or address mistakes entered by the customer. If you spot a mistake, contact us within 1 hour of ordering to adjust it.
  • Lost Packages: If your tracking shows no update for more than 10 consecutive business days, or if the estimated delivery window has passed and your package has not arrived, please contact our support team. We will file a tracer investigation with the carrier and send a replacement package if it is declared lost.
  • Damaged in Transit: If your package arrives damaged, please take photos of the box and product immediately and email them to us within 72 hours of receipt so we can issue a free replacement.

6. Contact Information

For any questions or support regarding shipping and delivery, please contact our customer care team at support@safepetstrap.com.
